rows.definition: SHA-256 identity of canonical configured runtime topology groups and ranks, including device incarnations, KV ownership and configured resource commitments, binding measured observations to their exact placement.
rows.distinction: Configured distributed placement identity, not tensor element ordering. LinkDigest, current free capacity and observation epoch are separate checks; a matching digest is not performance evidence.

rows.definition: Serialized StopReason literal emitted when unvisited runtime topology configurations remain and the number evaluated has reached MaxCandidates, truncating finite observed-only search.
rows.distinction: A search-stop reason indicating the evaluated-configuration cap, not ctxplan CandidateBound spans scored per turn, model memory capacity, token generation or the separate time_budget deadline. It does not claim an exhaustive optimum.
